title: As NFC South threatens another sub-.500 division winner, does NFL playoff structure need makeover? 'It'll take an egregious deal'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: As NFC South threatens another sub-.500 division winner, does NFL playoff structure need makeover? 'It'll take an egregious deal'
